search_assist.answer: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company known for its consumer electronics, software, and online services, founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne. Its popular products include the iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, and it is headquartered in Cupertino, California.
search_assist.expanded_answer:
## Overview of Apple Inc.

Apple Inc. is a leading American multinational technology company, headquartered in Cupertino, California. It was founded on April 1, 1976, by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne. Initially named Apple Computer Company, it was renamed Apple Inc. in 2007 to reflect its broader focus beyond computers.

## Key Products and Services

Apple is renowned for its innovative consumer electronics and software. Its main products include:

| Product Category      | Examples                          |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------------|
| Smartphones           | iPhone                            |
| Tablets               | iPad                              |
| Laptops               | MacBook Air, MacBook Pro         |
| Wearables             | Apple Watch                       |
| Home Devices          | Apple TV, HomePod                |
| Accessories           | AirPods, AirTag                  |

In addition to hardware, Apple offers various services such as:

| Service Category      | Examples                          |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------------|
| Streaming             | Apple Music, Apple TV+           |
| Cloud Services        | iCloud                            |
| Payment Services      | Apple Pay                         |
| App Store             | App distribution platform         |

## Financial Performance

As of 2025, Apple reported impressive financial figures:

- **Revenue**: $416 billion
- **Operating Income**: $133 billion
- **Number of Employees**: 166,000

## Corporate Structure

Apple operates globally with approximately 540 retail stores. The company is publicly traded on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol AAPL. Tim Cook serves as the CEO, and Arthur Levinson is the chairman.

Apple continues to be a dominant player in the technology sector, known for its commitment to innovation and customer loyalty.

knowledge_graph.title: Apple Inc.
knowledge_graph.description: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, best known for its consumer electronics, software and online services. Founded in 1976 as Apple Computer Company by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne, the company was incorporated by Jobs and Wozniak as Apple Computer, Inc. the following year. It was renamed to its current name in 2007 as the company had expanded its focus from computers to consumer electronics. Apple has been described as a Big Tech company. The company was founded in 1976 to market Wozniak's Apple I personal computer. Its successor, the Apple II, became one of the first successful mass-produced microcomputers. Apple introduced the Lisa in 1983 and the Macintosh in 1984 as some of the first computers to use a graphical user interface and a mouse.
